description: Elections Commission - M. A. P. S. Marasinghe of the Nattandiya Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of member of the Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna - J. P. M. Wirani of the Nattandiya Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of the member of the Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna
categorisation: This gazette notice announces that specific individuals have vacated their positions as members of the Nattandiya Pradeshiya Sabha due to ceasing membership in a political party. This falls under electoral processes and local authority member status changes, which is categorized under Elections Gazettes (Type 7) as it deals with the composition of elected local government bodies under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance.
